entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-16
entry.content:
Issues

  • dotnetup: move elevation and process-output helpers out of WindowsPathHelper #56681
  • Static web assets: publish-time Brotli compression ignores BrotliCompressionLevel #56679
  • `UninstallTargetNotFound` indicates UX Confusion for users - Support old install location cleanup? #56676

  • I want to override install location using environment variable #56671
  • Installing 11-daily or 10-daily builds fails with dotnetup #56670
